text:
maya-partners: Quick sync: pilot to onboard 3 listings (AWS/GCP/Azure) with private-offer support. Need ops runbook, contract text for telemetry & reseller addendum, and SKU CSV.

rachel-sdks: I can provide SDK examples and a sample curl. Pls share SKU CSV format.

tom-ops: Ops minimum: account numbers, role ARNs, kms_alias, image tag + manifest. Will create a spreadsheet. Also note azure needs billing project id.

liam-legal: Drafting short telemetry clause: raw meter events retained 90 days, aggregated billing 365 days. SI/reseller pricing requires addendum (fast-track 2-3 business days). Uploading draft to MP-3001.

esme-cloud: Region parity check: some Azure regions missing GPU SKU, add fallback_package_id. I'll fill region notes in ops sheet.

mp-bot: Created MP-3001 marketplace-private-offer-pilot. Assignees: @maya-partners @rachel-sdks @tom-ops @liam-legal @esme-cloud. https://jira.redwood/MP-3001

maya-partners: CSV template we want: product_id,cloud_offer_id,trial_days,private_offer_enabled,pricing_override,fallback_package_id,enablement_contact. Small sample: 
red-core,aws:rd-core-1,14,true,USD:200,red-core-fallback,maya@redwood.com
gpt-embed,gcp:embed-std,0,false,,embed-fallback,dev@redwood.com

rachel-sdks: Thanks - will add SDK snippet and example event payload. Tom: can you provide test endpoint + creds for ingest?

tom-ops: Yep. I'll post a curl with a short-lived test token and the required HMAC header by EOD.

liam-legal: Action: upload contract and addendum to MP-3001 by COB.

maya-partners: Timeline: collect artifacts today, enable pilots in staging tomorrow. Meeting at 10:30 PT to validate.
